summary: fix(auth): normalize PostgreSQL URL scheme for asyncpg dialect
decisions: Add _normalize_pgsql_url() to convert postgres:// and pgsql:// schemes to postgresql+asyncpg://

bugs.symptom: NoSuchModuleError: Can't load plugin: sqlalchemy.dialects:postgres on deployment
bugs.root_cause: ACCOUNT_POSTGRESQL_URL env var uses postgres:// scheme; SQLAlchemy dialect name is postgresql not postgres
bugs.fix: Normalize URL scheme in create_pgsql_engine() before passing to create_async_engine()
